# Robyn AI

> Robyn AI is an AI voice receptionist for small and medium businesses. It answers business phone calls 24/7 with a natural, human-like conversation, qualifies leads, books appointments, and handles customer inquiries, so businesses never miss a call.

Robyn AI answers in under 0.4 seconds, holds real two-way conversations instead of reading from a script or an IVR menu, and can lift booked calls by up to 38% compared to voicemail. It works over the phone and, via WhatsApp integration, in chat as well, in English, Spanish, and 30+ other languages. Setup takes under a day, with no developer required. Robyn AI is built for SMB service businesses: clinics, law firms, accountancy practices, restaurants, real estate agencies, insurance agencies, and home service trades (HVAC, plumbing, electricians) that receive frequent inbound calls and lose revenue every time one goes unanswered.

Core capabilities: taking messages, answering FAQs from a trained knowledge base, booking appointments directly into a calendar, qualifying and scoring leads, structured new-client intake, transferring calls to the right team member, after-hours and weekend coverage, overflow reception when lines are full, call recording with full transcripts, voicemail transcription, and integration with CRMs, calendars, Slack, and Zapier via API and webhooks.

## Solutions

- [Answering Service](https://www.robynai.co.uk/solutions/answering-service): Every call answered within seconds, day, night, weekend, or holiday, with a clean summary sent after each call.
- [Appointment Booking](https://www.robynai.co.uk/solutions/appointment-booking): Robyn reads your live calendar and books appointments on the call, with instant email and SMS confirmations and reminders.
- [After-Hours Calls](https://www.robynai.co.uk/solutions/after-hours-calls): Separate greeting, routing, and escalation rules for evenings, weekends, and holidays, with urgency detection and a morning summary.
- [Answer Questions](https://www.robynai.co.uk/solutions/answer-questions): Robyn answers caller questions from your uploaded FAQ and knowledge base in natural speech, with no menus or hold music.
- [Bilingual Answering](https://www.robynai.co.uk/solutions/bilingual-answering): Detects the caller's language from the first sentence and responds natively in English or Spanish, not machine-translated.
- [Call Routing](https://www.robynai.co.uk/solutions/call-routing): Robyn qualifies the caller's need and transfers to the right person in under a second.
- [WhatsApp Integration](https://www.robynai.co.uk/solutions/whatsapp-integration): Robyn AI handles customer conversations on WhatsApp Business, answering questions, booking appointments, and routing inquiries automatically, in English and Spanish.

## Capabilities

- [Appointment Taking](https://www.robynai.co.uk/capabilities/appointment-taking): Connects to Google Calendar, Outlook, Acuity, and Calendly to check live availability and prevent double-bookings.
- [Lead Qualification](https://www.robynai.co.uk/capabilities/lead-qualification): Asks your own qualifying questions (budget, timeline, company size, decision authority) and scores each lead in real time.
- [Client Intake](https://www.robynai.co.uk/capabilities/client-intake): Collects new-client details in a natural conversation and delivers a structured summary formatted for your CRM.
- [Call Recording](https://www.robynai.co.uk/capabilities/call-recording): Every call recorded automatically and paired with a full transcript in a library organized by date, caller, and topic.
- [Voicemail Transcription](https://www.robynai.co.uk/capabilities/voicemail-transcription): Messages transcribed instantly and delivered to your inbox.
- [Overflow Reception](https://www.robynai.co.uk/capabilities/overflow-reception): When your lines are full, calls route to Robyn automatically, with no limit on concurrent calls.
